constructs.name: cardiovascular_risk
constructs.description: Overall 10-year cardiovascular event risk integrating lipid, glycemic, hemodynamic, and inflammatory factors

constructs.name: lipid_burden
constructs.description: Atherogenic lipid profile reflecting LDL, triglycerides, and HDL balance

constructs.name: vascular_inflammation
constructs.description: Arterial wall inflammatory state driven by atherogenic lipid infiltration and immune activation

constructs.name: glycemic_control
constructs.description: Quality of blood glucose regulation reflecting insulin sensitivity and hepatic glucose output

constructs.name: arterial_pressure
constructs.description: Systemic blood pressure level reflecting vascular resistance and cardiac output

constructs.name: medication_adherence
constructs.description: Prescription fill rate and treatment compliance across all prescribed medications

constructs.name: genetic_predisposition
constructs.description: Inherited cardiovascular risk variants (LDLR, APOB, PCSK9, 9p21.3, APOE4) affecting lipid metabolism and vascular biology independently

constructs.name: psychosocial_stress
constructs.description: Chronic psychosocial burden (occupational stress, social isolation, depressive symptoms) driving neuroendocrine dysregulation

edges.description: Oxidized LDL infiltrates the arterial intima, recruiting monocytes and triggering foam cell formation (atherogenesis initiation)
Inflammatory plaque destabilization thins fibrous caps and promotes thrombosis, driving acute cardiovascular events
Chronic hyperglycemia generates advanced glycation end products (AGEs), accelerating micro- and macrovascular complications
Elevated blood pressure increases cardiac workload and accelerates atherosclerotic plaque progression
Atorvastatin inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing hepatic LDL synthesis
Metformin improves hepatic insulin sensitivity and reduces gluconeogenesis
Ramipril and amlodipine reduce systemic vascular resistance
Familial hypercholesterolemia variants (LDLR, APOB, PCSK9 gain-of-function) elevate baseline LDL cholesterol
9p21.3 risk locus and APOE4 confer lipid-independent cardiovascular risk through endothelial dysfunction and platelet hyperreactivity
Chronic HPA axis activation elevates cortisol, driving hepatic gluconeogenesis and peripheral insulin resistance
Sustained sympathetic overdrive and systemic inflammation from chronic stress independently increase cardiovascular event risk

indicators.name: hdl_cholesterol

indicators.name: crp
indicators.how_to_measure: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) in mg/L; marker of systemic and vascular inflammation

indicators.name: fibrinogen
indicators.how_to_measure: Plasma fibrinogen in g/L; acute-phase reactant reflecting inflammatory and prothrombotic state

indicators.name: hba1c
indicators.how_to_measure: Glycated hemoglobin %; lower = better control

indicators.name: fasting_glucose
indicators.how_to_measure: Fasting blood glucose in mmol/L

indicators.name: systolic_bp
indicators.how_to_measure: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg

indicators.name: diastolic_bp
indicators.how_to_measure: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg

indicators.name: resting_heart_rate
indicators.how_to_measure: Resting heart rate in bpm at consultation

indicators.name: prescription_renewals
indicators.how_to_measure: Proportion of prescriptions renewed on time via Doctolib (0–1, quarterly)

indicators.how_to_measure: Proportion of kept vs missed Doctolib appointments (0–1, quarterly)

lipid_burden.estimand: ∑_{vasc_infl} P(vasc_infl | lipid) ∑_{lipid'} P(cv_risk | lipid', vasc_infl) P(lipid')
lipid_burden.notes: Identified via front-door criterion through vascular_inflammation despite genetic confounding. genetic_predisposition confounds lipid_burden ↔ cardiovascular_risk, but vascular_inflammation mediates ALL directed paths from lipid_burden to cardiovascular_risk and has no unblocked backdoor from treatment to mediator.

messages.content: You are a clinical measurement specialist mapping latent constructs to observable biomarkers...

Map the 8 latent constructs to measurable clinical indicators extractable from this patient's Doctolib records (lab results, vitals, prescriptions). Note: genetic_predisposition and psychosocial_stress are unobserved — no indicators available.

I'll propose 12 indicators for the 6 observed constructs. The 2 unobserved confounders (genetic_predisposition, psychosocial_stress) have no indicators by design — they represent clinically important factors not captured in routine Doctolib records.
messages.reasoning: LDL + triglycerides + HDL for lipid_burden; hs-CRP + fibrinogen for vascular_inflammation (key mediator for frontdoor identification); HbA1c + fasting glucose for glycemic_control; systolic + diastolic BP + resting HR for arterial_pressure; prescription fills + appointment attendance for adherence. Cardiovascular risk has 0 direct indicators (second-order latent). vascular_inflammation indicators are essential — without them, the frontdoor criterion for lipid_burden’s effect would fail.

messages.content: 12 indicators mapped to 6 observed constructs. Identifiability check reveals a key contrast: lipid_burden’s effect on cardiovascular_risk IS identifiable via the front-door criterion through vascular_inflammation, despite genetic confounding. However, glycemic_control’s effect is NOT identifiable — psychosocial_stress confounds the relationship with no mediator or instrument available to recover the causal effect.

gate_overridden.reason: Glycemic control effect is non-identifiable due to psychosocial stress confounding. User chose to continue — the identified lipid_burden pathway (via frontdoor) and arterial_pressure pathway provide sufficient causal targets for intervention analysis.
